target.title: fix(agents): reject with AbortError when tool execution is cancelled
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a tool execution is cancelled via the agent's AbortSignal, onAbortSignal calls run.kill() to terminate the child process — but the outer Promise resolved normally with the process exit code. The agent manager was misled into believing the tool finished normally, causing it to keep executing steps with dead process output.

## Why This Change Was Made

The process exit handler always called resolve(buildExecForegroundResult(...)) regardless of whether the exit was caused by an abort signal. Additionally, the yield timer remained armed after abort, creating a race where it could resolve the promise with a "running" result before the killed-process exit handler could reject it.

## User Impact

- Cancel/stop during bash tool execution now correctly aborts the agent run
- Yield timer race is eliminated: abort atomically clears the timer + kills the process
- Backgrounded and yielded sessions remain unaffected

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `afe3cc92cdbbfff2573062dc6441a98f8b02e4d9`

### Rank-up P1 — agent stop during exec (before/after)

# Agent-path abort-during-exec proof — PR #105726

Fixes #105681. No secrets. Local `sleep` only.

## Production chain

`run AbortController` (sessions.abort / embedded handle.abort)
→ `wrapToolWithAbortSignal`
→ `toToolDefinitions.execute`
→ `createExecTool.onAbortSignal`

## BEFORE (unpatched main-shaped exec)

```text
[2026-07-13T17:12:41.631Z] PROOF START — agent-path stop during exec (#105726)
[2026-07-13T17:12:41.637Z] cwd=/Users/sm/zw_openclaw pid=10277
[2026-07-13T17:12:41.639Z] tools wired: exec, proof_step2_marker
[2026-07-13T17:12:41.639Z] TURN START: step1=exec(sleep), planned step2=proof_step2_marker
[2026-07-13T17:12:42.142Z] OPERATOR STOP: runAbort.abort() (agent run cancel / sessions.abort shape)
[2026-07-13T17:12:42.153Z] STEP1 RESOLVED (unexpected): {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Command aborted by signal SIGTERM"}],"details":{"status":"failed","exitCode":null,"exitSignal":"SIGTERM","failureKind":"signal","exitReason":"manual-cancel",...
[2026-07-13T17:12:42.153Z] TURN CONTINUES (bug path): invoking step2
[2026-07-13T17:12:42.241Z] step2Calls=0
[2026-07-13T17:12:42.241Z] PROOF FAIL
```

Unpatched exec **resolves** a normal tool result (`SIGTERM` / failed details) after kill, so the agent-manager loop can continue to later steps.

## AFTER (PR #105726 patch)

```text
[2026-07-13T17:14:21.826Z] PROOF START — agent-path stop during exec (#105726)
[2026-07-13T17:14:21.829Z] patch: toolAborted + AbortError reject + yieldTimer clear (PR #105726)
[2026-07-13T17:14:21.832Z] tools wired: exec, proof_step2_marker
[2026-07-13T17:14:21.832Z] TURN START: step1=exec(sleep 30), planned step2=proof_step2_marker
[2026-07-13T17:14:22.334Z] OPERATOR STOP: runAbort.abort() (sessions.abort / embedded handle.abort shape)
[2026-07-13T17:14:22.341Z] STEP1 REJECTED: name=AbortError message=Tool execution was aborted
[2026-07-13T17:14:22.341Z] TURN END: step1 aborted — agent manager skips later tool steps
[2026-07-13T17:14:22.341Z] step2Calls=0
[2026-07-13T17:14:22.342Z] PROOF PASS — abort ends turn; no later tool step
```

Patched exec **rejects** `AbortError`; turn ends; `proof_step2_marker` never executes (`step2Calls=0`).

## Result

PASS (after) — Rank-up P1 agent stop/cancel path demonstrated on production wrap + adapter + exec chain.


### Prior L1 coverage (still valid)

- Unit: `rejects with AbortError when abort fires before yield window expires`
- Standalone helper transcript (exec-only) remains supplementary; the agent-path proof above is the Rank-up requirement.

## What Changed

- src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts: +13 lines (toolAborted flag + clear yieldTimer + AbortError rejection)
- src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts: +23 lines (regression test for yield timer race)

Fixes #105681
